user.title: Connect to Bramwell
user.description: Point this companion at your Bramwell brain. The brain registers Alfred as a HA conversation.agent — pick it from the Assist pipeline dropdown to talk to Alfred from a Voice PE puck or any HA Assist surface. Optionally point at a Kokoro TTS endpoint for the canonical Alfred voice.

data_description.brain_url: The URL where your Bramwell brain is reachable from Home Assistant. Default works when Bramwell runs as a HA add-on.
data_description.api_token: Long-lived bearer token issued by the Bramwell dashboard (Settings → API tokens).
data_description.kokoro_url: Optional. URL of a Kokoro TTS endpoint (e.g. `http://homeassistant.local:8880` for Bramwell's docker-compose `voice` profile). Leave blank to use HA's default TTS or the community Wyoming-Kokoro add-on instead.
data_description.kokoro_voice: Kokoro voice id. Default `bm_george` is the canonical British-male Alfred.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the brain at that URL. Check the URL, your network, and that Bramwell is running.
error.invalid_auth: The brain rejected the API token. Issue a new one in the Bramwell dashboard.
error.unexpected_response: The URL responded but didn't look like a Bramwell brain. Double-check the URL.
error.kokoro_unreachable: Couldn't reach Kokoro at that URL. Check the URL and that the `voice` compose profile is running, or leave blank to disable Bramwell TTS.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Bramwell brain is already configured.
